name: context-menu-15
description: A browser tab strip where each tab can be pinned, muted, duplicated, or closed via its menu.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Globe as GlobeIcon, VolumeX as VolumeXIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const initialTabs = [ { id: 1, title: "designali.com", pinned: true, muted: false }, { id: 2, title: "Designali Blocks", pinned: false, muted: false }, { id: 3, title: "Figma: brand kit", pinned: false, muted: true }, ] export default function BrowserTabStripMenu() { const [tabs, setTabs] = React.useState(initialTabs) const patch = (id: number, changes: Partial<(typeof initialTabs)[number]>) => setTabs((list) => list.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, ...changes } : t))) return (
{tabs.map((tab) => ( {tab.pinned ? null : {tab.title}} {tab.muted ? ( ) : null} New tab to the right Reload ⌘R setTabs((list) => [ ...list, { ...tab, id: Date.now(), pinned: false }, ]) } > Duplicate patch(tab.id, { pinned })} > Pin tab patch(tab.id, { muted })} > Mute site setTabs((list) => list.filter((t) => t.id !== tab.id)) } > Close tab ⌘W setTabs([tab])} > Close other tabs ))}
) }
